spans.s:
(इ) लुबि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लुम्बति लुम्बयति)
To hurt, to pain, to afflict or torment.
r. 10th cl. (लुम्बयति)
To disappear.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Covetous, greedy, desirous, cupidinous.
m. (-ब्धः)
1 A hunter.
2 A lecher, a libertine.
E.
लुभ to desire, to wish for vehemently, to covet, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A hunter.
2 A libertine, a rake, a whoremonger.
3 A covetous or greedy man.
E.
लुब्ध desirous, aff. कन्.
